facts.business: TBO Tek Limited operates a global travel distribution platform connecting travel buyers and suppliers, offering hotels, airlines, ancillaries, and emerging travel products through technology and human expertise.

guidance_or_targets.statement: TBO's India business is well positioned to deliver profitable and sustainable growth in FY 2027.

auditor.name: S.R. Batliboi & Co. LLP
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on uncertainty relating to outcome of show cause notice received by the Company for certain non-compliances under Foreign Exchange Management Act, 1999 (FEMA).

key_risks: Geopolitical / Regional conflicts, travel advisories, airspace restrictions, sanctions and aviation incidents may disrupt important travel corridors and affect demand patterns.
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with the related parties are in compliance with sections 177 and 188 of Companies Act, 2013 where applicable and the details have been disclosed in the notes to the financial statements, as required by the applicable accounting standards.
